children: Chief Revenue Officer Ken Leith to present on Tuesday, October 20, at 4:30 p.m. Pacific Time

("First Breach" or the "Company"), an American-made defense technologies company focused on vertically integrated ammunition production and next-generation unmanned aerial systems, today announced that Chief Revenue Officer Ken Leith will present at the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event, taking place October 19-21, 2026, at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles, California.

Mr. Leith is scheduled to present on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Pacific Time. His presentation will provide an overview of First Breach's business, including its ammunition manufacturing operations and the development of its proprietary unmanned aerial systems.

Mr. Leith will also be available for one-on-one investor meetings on Tuesday, October 20. Investors interested in meeting with First Breach can request a meeting through LD Micro or contact the Company's investor relations representative below.
Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel, Los Angeles, California
About the LD Micro Main Event XX

The 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event will take place October 19-21, 2026, at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles. The conference brings together public companies and investors for company presentations, private meetings, and networking opportunities. First Breach Inc. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified, American-made defense technologies company focused on manufacturing match-grade ammunition components, finished ammunition, and developing next-generation unmanned aerial systems for commercial, law enforcement, and military markets. The Company manufactures its products in-house at its Hagerstown, Maryland facility, where it produces brass cups, casings, projectiles, lead cores, lead wire, and completed ammunition with rigorous quality control standards. First Breach is also advancing its drone strategy through the development of U.S.-made unmanned systems, leveraging advanced engineering, robotics, ISR and sensor technologies, and precision manufacturing capabilities to address evolving defense, homeland security, law enforcement, and commercial requirements across domestic and international markets.
